system.description: If your first Attack is an Amazing Success or better, your second Attack (if it hits) is upgraded to a Critical Hit.

upgrades.description: Roll your first Attack with Advantage.
If your first Attack is a Standard Success or better, the second Attack (if it hits) is upgraded to a Critical Hit.
Roll your second Attack with Advantage. If your second Attack is a Critical Hit or upgraded to one, deal x3 damage (instead of x2).

system.limitations: To engage this Skill, you must declare a Double Tap at the start of the combat round, before Mob Actions have been determined. You must then use all of your Actions this round to Attack a single target with the same weapon or Spell. Mark this Skill for advancement anytime you roll an Amazing Success or better while using it.
